interpretation: Percentile consensus is a relative within-mark regulatory-context measure; it is not an absolute cross-study quantification of ChIP enrichment.

peak_feature_policy.binary_features: Preserve condition-level prevalence and study-level support. Equal-study weighted condition fractions are reported explicitly.
peak_feature_policy.continuous_peak_features: Median of study-level medians. Cross-study range is reported only when two studies are available.

spmr_policy.cross_study_consensus: Arithmetic mean of within-study percentiles with equal study weight.
spmr_policy.cross_study_disagreement: Absolute difference between the two study percentiles when two studies are available; NA for single-study marks because cross-study disagreement is not applicable.
spmr_policy.harmonization: Within each histone-mark x study, the 37 loci are converted to average-rank percentiles using (rank-1)/(n-1), with mid-ranks for ties.

secondary_context_feature.reason: Benchmark loci have heterogeneous interval widths and exact-locus SPMR showed more zero/tied values and weaker cross-study agreement.

workflow: ChIP-seq locus x histone-mark cross-study consensus
